highlights: Open-source models are demonstrating significant advancements in specialized domains like scientific discovery and finance, with new releases offering competitive performance against frontier models at a fraction of the cost, driving accessibility and efficiency for builders.

The agentic AI ecosystem is rapidly maturing, with new tools enabling agents to interact with operating systems and enterprise data (e.g., semantic layers), alongside open-source coding agents and cost-optimization plugins, empowering developers to build more capable and efficient AI systems.

Strategic partnerships between major AI developers and large enterprises are accelerating AI's integration into critical business workflows, from legal and financial services to cloud platforms, indicating a strong move towards production-grade, integrated AI solutions.

agents.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
agents.summary: DeepSeek released an MIT-licensed, open-source router-worker coding agent (dsh-superagent) that significantly reduces task completion times, offering developers a powerful tool for accelerating parallel development workflows.

agents.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
agents.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that enables any AI agent to gain full computer access on macOS, Windows, and Linux by interacting with OS accessibility trees, vastly expanding agent operational capabilities.

agents.title: Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 at 11x Lower Cost
agents.summary: Samaya AI's Sterling is a specialized 3B-active finance research agent model that significantly outperforms Claude Fable 5.1 on financial benchmarks at an 11x lower cost, providing a highly efficient and cost-effective solution for financial analysis.

models.title: Deep Principle Releases Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for Scientific Discovery
models.summary: Deep Principle has released Hydrogen-1.0, a 753B open-weight model specialized for scientific discovery in chemistry, materials science, and life sciences, claiming a research win over GPT-6-Astra and providing advanced scientific AI under an MIT License.

models.title: Google AI Blog: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
models.summary: Google has announced Gemini 4 Argon, its latest frontier model, offering developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers access to a powerful new AI for tackling complex challenges.

models.title: Nace AI Open-Sources Drex Max v1: A 27B Decision Model That Runs Locally on Apple Silicon
models.summary: Nace AI open-sourced Drex Max v1, a 27B multimodal decision model designed for local inference on Apple Silicon, enabling high-performance, privacy-preserving AI applications on consumer hardware.

tools.title: NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL
tools.summary: NVIDIA released Auto Ontology, an Apache 2.0 library that generates an open semantic layer from enterprise metadata, enabling AI agents to ground SQL queries in certified definitions and receive contextual information via MCP, CLI, and API.

tools.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
tools.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that gives any AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows, and Linux by reading OS accessibility trees and acting on stable references, expanding agent automation capabilities.

tools.title: Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
tools.summary: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from past sessions to reduce coding agent token costs by 18.4% to 30.9% without modifying the agent, offering significant operational savings for developers.

companies.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
companies.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow are expanding their partnership to integrate OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow workflows and bring ServiceNow functionalities into ChatGPT and Codex, accelerating enterprise AI adoption.

companies.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to integrate Oracle's business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT, while also powering new Oracle offerings, signifying a deep integration of AI into enterprise software.

companies.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
companies.summary: OpenAI has launched the Grid Protectors Program, a new initiative to collaborate with utilities to enhance grid reliability and manage consumer electricity costs for future compute campuses, addressing critical infrastructure challenges with AI.

learning.title: Google AI Blog: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
learning.summary: Google has released 'Polar Peaks,' a new AI Quests lesson focused on neuroscience and mapping the human brain, providing an engaging learning opportunity for AI literacy.

learning.title: Google AI Blog: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games
learning.summary: Google's new experimental gaming platform, Playground, allows users to create, play, and share custom games, offering a hands-on learning environment for generative AI in game development.

learning.title: arXiv cs.AI: Towards Portable Specification of the Agent Harness
learning.summary: This research paper proposes a portable specification framework that decomposes the agent harness into eight functional components, serving as a critical guide for developers to understand, compare, and version their agent infrastructure effectively.
